name: Seedream 5 Pro
description: Seedream 5.0 Pro is ByteDance's flagship multimodal image generation and interactive precision editing model. Designed for professional creative workflows, it features native layer separation, interactive grounded editing, high-density multilingual typography, and multi-reference consistency up to 4K resolution.
keyFeatures: Native Layered & Interactive Local Editing: Point selection, lasso selection, sketch guidance, and material swapping without altering unselected regions
High-Density Multilingual Typography: Advanced layout and text rendering optimized for infographics across 10-14 languages
Multi-Reference Consistency Control: Accepts up to 10 reference images simultaneously to maintain strict character, object, and style consistency
High-Resolution Photorealistic Rendering: Produces outputs up to 4K resolution with lifelike lighting and CG-level expressiveness
API & Ecosystem Integration: Integrated into BytePlus ModelArk API and compatible with Seedance video generation pipelines
curatorNotes: Verified release from ByteDance Seed Research Team. Commercial API access via BytePlus ModelArk.
